most_recent_paper.title: Possible Couplings of Dark Matter
most_recent_paper.detection_method: Theoretical analysis of dark matter couplings to other fields, including non-minimal coupling to Ricci scalar and connection to inflaton

papers.title: The Dark Energy Survey
papers.summary: Describes the Dark Energy Survey (DES) for measuring dark energy and dark matter densities through four methods: galaxy clusters, weak gravitational lensing tomography, galaxy angular clustering, and supernova distances.
papers.detection_method: Indirect detection via astronomical surveys and gravitational effects

papers.title: Possible Couplings of Dark Matter
papers.summary: Theoretical review of different ways dark matter may couple to other fields, examining non-minimal coupling approaches and connections to inflation theory.
papers.detection_method: Theoretical analysis of dark matter couplings and interactions

papers.title: Dark Matter in the Coming Decade: Complementary Paths to Discovery and Beyond
papers.summary: Comprehensive review of dark matter search strategies through four approaches: direct detection, indirect detection, collider experiments, and astrophysical probes.
papers.detection_method: Multi-approach strategy combining direct detection, indirect detection, colliders, and astrophysical observations

papers.title: Direct dark matter detection: the next decade
papers.summary: Review of direct dark matter detection techniques and future prospects, focusing on ultimate WIMP detectors capable of probing cross sections down to 1e-48 cm2.
papers.detection_method: Direct detection using underground detectors to measure WIMP-nucleon interactions

papers.title: Directional detection of Dark Matter
papers.authors: F. Mayet, J. Billard, D. Santos
papers.summary: Review of directional dark matter detection strategy that exploits Earth's motion through the dark matter halo to identify direction-dependent WIMP events.
papers.detection_method: Directional detection measuring both energy and 3D tracks of low-energy nuclear recoils
